clinic.name: Brewer Dental Center
clinic.tagline: Your premier dental choice for the entire family.
clinic.hours: Open early and late, 24/7 Emergency Support
clinic.heroSubtitle: Experience life-changing dental implants and All-On-4 restorations at Billings' award-winning clinic, where we combine advanced expertise with flexible financing and sedation options.

differentiators.title: Voted Best In Billings
differentiators.description: Proudly recognized as the Best Dental Practice by the Billings Gazette for 14 years in a row by our local community.

differentiators.title: All-In-One Convenience
differentiators.description: Our team of general dentists, specialists, and hygienists work under one roof to complete your work quickly and seamlessly.

differentiators.title: The Smile Squad Plan
differentiators.description: We offer an exclusive in-house membership plan that provides members significant savings of up to 80% on dental services.

differentiators.title: Patient-Centric Approach
differentiators.description: We have evolved our practice based on patient feedback to prioritize ease of scheduling, financial options, and comfort.

treatmentJourney.title: Comprehensive Consultation
treatmentJourney.description: Begin with a thorough assessment where our team listens to your goals and uses advanced imaging to map out your personalized implant plan.

treatmentJourney.title: Foundation Preparation
treatmentJourney.description: We ensure your oral health is ready for implants, addressing any underlying issues or tooth removals to create a healthy environment for your new smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Precise Implant Placement
treatmentJourney.description: Our expert dentists perform the implant procedure using gentle techniques and sedation options to ensure your absolute comfort and safety.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing and Integration
treatmentJourney.description: During this phase, the implant naturally fuses with your bone, creating a stable and permanent foundation for your final restoration.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Restoration Design
treatmentJourney.description: We take precise impressions to craft a custom crown or bridge that perfectly matches the color, shape, and fit of your natural teeth.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Smile Reveal
treatmentJourney.description: Your custom-made restoration is securely attached, giving you a functional, beautiful, and confident smile that is designed to last a lifetime.

benefits.title: Extended Office Hours
benefits.description: We are open early and stay late to ensure dental care fits into your busy life without the need for multiple trips.

benefits.title: Sedation For Anxiety
benefits.description: Relax during your visit with our range of comfort measures and sedation options designed to help you feel safe and calm.

benefits.title: Flexible Financing
benefits.description: Access high-quality care with affordable options including our Smile Squad Plan which offers savings up to 80%.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Family Care
benefits.description: From pediatric dentistry to orthodontics and restorative care, we serve every member of your family under one roof.

benefits.title: Emergency 24/7 Access
benefits.description: Dental emergencies don't wait for business hours, which is why we are available to assist you 24 hours a day.

benefits.title: Voted Best Practice
benefits.description: Trust your smile to the clinic voted 'Best Dental Practice' by the Billings Gazette for 14 consecutive years.

implantOptions.title: All-On-4 Implants
implantOptions.description: A comprehensive solution to replace a full arch of teeth using just four strategically placed dental implants.

implantOptions.title: Single Dental Implants
implantOptions.description: Permanent restorations that look, feel, and function like natural teeth to replace individual missing teeth.

implantOptions.title: Implant-Supported Dentures
implantOptions.description: Combine the affordability of dentures with the stability of implants for a secure, non-slip smile.

faqItems.question: Do you offer any options for patients without insurance?
faqItems.answer: Yes! We offer the Smile Squad Plan, a membership program that can save you up to 80% on all dental services, plus cash specials for new patients.

faqItems.question: Can I bring my whole family at once?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. We are open early and late to make it easy to schedule checkups for the entire family in a single trip.

faqItems.question: What should I do if I have a dental emergency?
faqItems.answer: Please call us immediately. We provide emergency dentistry services and are available 24/7 to help you in urgent situations.

faqItems.question: Is sedation dentistry available for anxious patients?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we offer a range of comfort measures and sedation options to help those with dental anxiety feel relaxed and safe during treatment.

faqItems.question: Do you provide pediatric dental services?
faqItems.answer: We specialize in children's dentistry, offering a $99 Pediatric New Patient Cash Special that includes an exam, x-rays, cleaning, and fluoride.

faqItems.question: How do I schedule my first appointment?
faqItems.answer: You can request an appointment online or call us at (406) 656-6100. We have three convenient locations in Heights and West End Billings.

clinic.footerAbout: Brewer Dental Center has been serving families in Billings and across Yellowstone County for many years with compassionate, comprehensive care built around the needs of the patient.

doctor.name: James Galea
doctor.bio: Dr. James Galea is a key member of the expert team at Brewer Dental Center, specializing in orthodontics. He provides free consultations for families to review bite concerns and explore modern treatment options. Working within a practice voted Best Dental Practice in Billings for 14 consecutive years, Dr. Galea is dedicated to delivering specialized care that is easy, accessible, and tailored to the individual needs of both children and adults.

reviews.name: Marcus L.
reviews.text: Brewer Dental Center made it so easy to get my whole family in at once. The late hours are a lifesaver for my work schedule!

reviews.name: Elena R.
reviews.text: I've always had dental anxiety, but the sedation options here made me feel completely safe and relaxed. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: David W.
reviews.text: The Smile Squad Plan saved me a fortune on my dental work. It's great to find a place that actually helps with the financial side.

reviews.name: Sarah K.
reviews.text: Dr. Galea was fantastic with my son's braces. He explained everything clearly during our free consultation.

reviews.name: Brian H.
reviews.text: Best dental experience in Billings. I needed emergency help on a weekend and they were there for me 24/7. Exceptional care.

reviews.name: Jessica M.
reviews.text: I love that they have specialists and general dentists all in one building. My implant procedure was seamless from start to finish.
